answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 168978 Country: Pakistan Title: The name of baby Boy Question: We decided the name of my son is Muhammad Hadi Murtaza age of 45 days but one of our relative asked us it is not correct and says that you must change name and decided as Abdul Hadi. But I like name "Muhammad" and all the time I call him Muhammad. Please guide me is it compulsory to decide name Abdul Hadi instead of Muhammad Hadi? Answer ID: 168978 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 676/598/M=06/1440) If you want to keep the word Hadi in the name of your son then you should prefix it with Abd and keep the name Abdul Hadi or Muhammad al-Hadi. You can call your son by the name Muhammad as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
